DASHBOARD.NO_CHART_DATA_TEXT: There are not enough portfolio snapshots to show the evolution for this period.
DASHBOARD.DISTRIBUTION_EMPTY_TEXT: When you have assets in your portfolio, the sector distribution will appear here.
DASHBOARD.NOTIFICATIONS_EMPTY_TEXT: When an alert is triggered, it will appear here.
DASHBOARD.TRANSACTIONS_EMPTY_TEXT: When you buy or sell assets, they will appear here.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_TOTAL_VALUE: Total value is the sum of everything you have invested right now, calculated at the current price of each asset.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_ACTIVE_ASSETS: Indicates how many different assets you currently hold in your portfolio. An asset can be a stock, ETF, or other investment instrument.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_TODAY_PROFIT: Shows how much you gained or lost today with your simulated investments. A positive number means your assets rose in value; negative means they fell.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_ACTIVE_ALERTS: These are the alerts you configured that are waiting for a condition to be met, such as a stock reaching a certain price.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_CHART_COMPARE: This chart compares how your portfolio grew against two real market indices. It helps you see whether your simulated decisions are better or worse than following the market in general.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_TIME_PERIOD: Choose the time period to display in the chart: 1W = last week, 1M = last month, 3M = last 3 months, 1Y = last year. Longer periods show the general trend; shorter periods show recent movements.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_CHART_TYPE: Change how the chart is displayed. The line shows continuous price evolution; bars allow comparing values between specific dates.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_DISTRIBUTION: Shows how your investments are spread across different sectors such as technology, energy, or finance. Good diversification helps reduce risk.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_NOTIFICATIONS: Here you can see the most recent alerts generated by your alerts. For example, when a stock reached the price you configured.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_TRANSACTIONS: These are the latest simulated buy and sell operations you performed. Lets you review your recent activity history on the platform.
DASHBOARD.COMPOSITION_EMPTY_TEXT: No snapshots available for the selected date.
DASHBOARD.TOOLTIP_COMPOSITION: Shows how your capital was distributed between available cash and invested capital on the selected date. Change the date to explore your history.

MARKET.TITLE: Market
MARKET.SUBTITLE: Explore market assets
MARKET.NAME: Company
MARKET.SEARCH_PROMPT_DESC: Enter a symbol to see price, metrics and evolution.
MARKET.NO_ASSET_SELECTED_TEXT: Search for a symbol to see price evolution compared to the market.
MARKET.NO_NEWS_TEXT: When there are major market reports, they will appear here.
MARKET.NO_TRENDING_TEXT: There are no featured assets to show yet.
MARKET.NO_GAINERS_TEXT: When the market reports top gainers, they will appear here.
MARKET.NO_LOSERS_TEXT: When the market reports top losers, they will appear here.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_INDEX_SP500: The S&P 500 groups the 500 largest companies in the United States. It is the most widely used reference index for the American market.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_INDEX_NASDAQ: The NASDAQ primarily concentrates technology companies like Apple, Google, and Microsoft. It reflects how the tech sector of the market is performing.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_INDEX_DOW: The Dow Jones groups only 30 large traditional industrial companies in the US. It is one of the oldest and most well-known indices in the world.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_INDEX_RUT: The Russell 2000 groups the 2000 small-cap companies in the US. It is the benchmark index for Small Caps in the American market.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_INDEX_DEFAULT: This index groups a set of stocks to show how a part of the market is performing.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_STAT_OPEN: The price at which the stock opened at the beginning of today's session.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_STAT_VOLUME: Number of shares traded today. High volume may indicate greater interest or activity in the asset.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_STAT_DAY_HIGH: The highest price the stock reached during today's session.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_STAT_DAY_LOW: The lowest price the stock touched during today's session.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_STAT_AVG_VOL: Average shares traded per day recently. Useful for comparing whether today has more or less activity than usual.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_STAT_MKT_CAP: Market capitalization: the total value of the company on the stock exchange. Calculated by multiplying the stock price by the total number of shares.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_STAT_PE_RATIO: Price-to-earnings ratio: indicates how much investors pay per unit of the company's earnings. A high value may mean the market expects strong growth.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_STAT_DIV_YIELD: Dividend yield: percentage the company pays to shareholders relative to the current price. It is a way to earn returns in addition to price appreciation.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_CHART_COMPARE: This chart compares the performance of the selected asset against the S&P 500, NASDAQ, and Dow Jones. It helps you see if the asset moves better or worse than the overall market.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_CHART_CANDLESTICK: The candlestick chart shows the opening, closing, high, and low price for each period. Useful for analyzing the internal movement of the selected asset.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_ASSET_INFO: This section shows the main information for the asset: its name, current price, and change from the previous day's close.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_NEWS: Recent financial news from the market. Real-world events can affect asset prices, so staying informed is valuable.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_TRENDING: Assets with the highest trading activity right now. High volume may indicate something important is happening with that stock.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_GAINERS: Assets that rose the most in price today. They may reflect good news about the company or its sector.
MARKET.TOOLTIP_LOSERS: Assets that fell the most in price today. They may reflect bad news, mass selling, or negative market results.

PORTFOLIO.TITLE: Portfolio
PORTFOLIO.SUBTITLE: Manage your investments
PORTFOLIO.RESET_CONFIRM_MSG: Are you sure you want to reset your portfolio? All positions and transactions will be deleted. Your balance will return to the initial amount.

MODAL.TOOLTIP_SYMBOL: The unique code that identifies a company on the market. For example, AAPL is Apple, MSFT is Microsoft, and TSLA is Tesla. Search for the symbol and press the search button to get the current price.
MODAL.TOOLTIP_QUANTITY: The number of shares you want to buy. You can buy from 1 unit. The total cost is calculated by multiplying this quantity by the market price.
MODAL.TOOLTIP_PRICE: The current market price of the stock at the time of the query. This is the price at which your simulated purchase will be executed.
MODAL.TOOLTIP_TOTAL_COST: The money that will be deducted from your balance when confirming the purchase. Calculated as: Quantity × Market price.
MODAL.TOOLTIP_BALANCE: The money you have available to invest. If the total cost exceeds this amount, the purchase cannot be confirmed.
MODAL.TOOLTIP_SELL_TYPE: You can sell all your shares or just a portion (partial sale). What you don't sell will remain in your portfolio.
MODAL.TOOLTIP_AVG_PRICE: The average price at which you bought these shares. If you bought at different times, the weighted average of all purchases is shown.
MODAL.TOOLTIP_PROFIT: The difference between what you will receive from the sale and what you originally paid. Positive means you made money; negative means you lost.
MODAL.TOOLTIP_PROFIT_PCT: The gain or loss expressed as a percentage of what you invested. For example, +15% means you recover your original investment plus an extra 15%.
MODAL.LOADING_POSITION: Looking up your position in each portfolio...

SELL_PROMPT.TITLE: Sell asset
SELL_PROMPT.SUBTITLE: Enter the ticker you want to sell. We'll look up which of your portfolios holds that position.

PORTFOLIO.EMPTY_HOLDINGS_TEXT: Buy an asset to start building your portfolio.
PORTFOLIO.EMPTY_FILTER_TEXT: No positions match the applied filters.
PORTFOLIO.EMPTY_OPERATIONS_TEXT: Your buys and sells will appear here.
PORTFOLIO.EMPTY_FILTER_OPS_TEXT: No operations match the applied filters.
PORTFOLIO.EMPTY_PIE_TEXT: Make your first purchase to see the distribution.
PORTFOLIO.EMPTY_LINE_TEXT: Data will appear once there are recorded operations.
PORTFOLIO.MARKET_HOURS_NOTE: Operations made after market close (4:00 PM NY) will be reflected on the next trading day.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_AVAILABLE_BALANCE: This is the money available in your account for trading, not including the value of your open investments.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_PROFIT_LOSS: This is the total result since you started the simulation (total balance minus initial balance). It is made up of 'realized' gains (locked in when you sell) and 'unrealized' gains (the appreciation of your open investments at today's price). Selling at market price does not change this total — it only converts an unrealized gain into a realized one.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_TOTAL_BALANCE: This is the money available in your account plus the current value of all your open investments, calculated at today's market price.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_DAILY_OPS: Indicates how many operations (buys or sells) you have performed today out of the maximum allowed. There is a daily limit to simulate real market conditions.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_DISTRIBUTION: Shows how your money is distributed across the different assets you hold. Diversifying across several assets helps reduce risk.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_EVOLUTION_CHART: Shows how the total value of your portfolio changed over time. Each point represents the value at the market close on that date.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_HOLDINGS: These are the assets you currently hold in your portfolio. For each one you can see how much you bought, at what price, and how it has performed since.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_HOLDING_SYMBOL: The unique symbol that identifies the stock. For example, AAPL is Apple and MSFT is Microsoft.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_HOLDING_SECTOR: The economic sector the company belongs to, such as technology, energy, or finance.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_HOLDING_QUANTITY: The number of shares of this asset you hold in your simulated portfolio.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_HOLDING_AVG_PRICE: The average price at which you purchased shares of this asset.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_HOLDING_CURRENT_PRICE: The current market price of this asset, updated in real time.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_HOLDING_CHANGE_PCT: The percentage change between the purchase price and the current price.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_HOLDING_PROFIT: The monetary difference between what you paid and what it is worth now.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_HOLDING_ACTIONS: Available options to operate with this asset. You can sell it directly from here.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_OPERATIONS: The complete history of all simulated buys and sells you have performed on the platform.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_OP_DATE: The exact date and time when the buy or sell operation was performed.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_OP_SYMBOL: The symbol of the traded stock. For example, AAPL is Apple and MSFT is Microsoft.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_OP_SECTOR: The economic sector the company belongs to, such as technology, energy, or finance.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_OP_TYPE: Indicates whether it was a purchase (you acquired shares) or a sale (you sold them).
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_OP_QUANTITY: The number of shares you bought or sold in that operation.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_OP_PRICE: The price per share at the time the operation was performed.
PORTFOLIO.TOOLTIP_OP_TOTAL: The total amount of the operation: share price multiplied by the quantity bought or sold.

CREATE_DIALOG.TITLE: Create Alert
CREATE_DIALOG.SUBTITLE: Configure an alert to monitor the price of an asset
CREATE_DIALOG.ACTIVE_DESC: Will send notifications when the condition is met
CREATE_DIALOG.TOOLTIP_ASSET: The asset is the stock or financial instrument you want to monitor. Each company trades with a unique code called a ticker or symbol, such as AAPL for Apple or GOOGL for Alphabet.
CREATE_DIALOG.TOOLTIP_CONDITION: The condition defines when you want to receive the alert. You can be notified when the price exceeds or falls below an exact dollar value, or when the day's change exceeds a percentage (useful for detecting sharp moves).
CREATE_DIALOG.TOOLTIP_PRICE: The exact dollar price at which you want the alert to trigger. Example: if you set $200 with the 'greater than' condition, you will receive an alert when the stock exceeds that price.
CREATE_DIALOG.TOOLTIP_PERCENT: The percentage change from the previous day's close that will trigger the alert. Example: if you set 5% with 'rise greater than', you will be notified when the stock rises more than 5% that day.
CREATE_DIALOG.TOOLTIP_STATUS: An active alert monitors the price in real time and notifies you when the condition is met. If you pause it, it is saved but does not generate notifications until you reactivate it.

CONDITIONS.GTE: Price greater than or equal to
CONDITIONS.LTE: Price less than or equal to

ALERTS.TOOLTIP_ACTIVE: These are the alerts monitoring the market right now. When a stock meets the configured condition, you will receive a notification.
ALERTS.TOOLTIP_PAUSED: Alerts you have temporarily deactivated. They will not trigger until you reactivate them.
ALERTS.TOOLTIP_TRIGGERED: Number of alerts triggered today because the asset met the condition you configured.
ALERTS.TOOLTIP_USED: How many alerts you have created out of the maximum allowed. There is a limit to keep the system organized.
ALERTS.TOOLTIP_CONDITION: Defines when the alert will trigger. For example: 'price greater than $150' or 'daily change greater than 5%'.
ALERTS.TOOLTIP_STATUS_COL: Indicates whether the alert is monitoring the market (Active) or temporarily deactivated (Paused).
ALERTS.TOOLTIP_DATES: The date you created the alert and the last time it was automatically triggered.
